diagnostics.candidate_recall: Retain-candidate decisions on useful gold cases / useful gold cases; distinct from semantic finding retention.
diagnostics.category_accuracy: Accepted relationship matches / scored cases, INCLUDING unknown/unknown as matches. category_accuracy_excluding_unknown_unknown reported separately; neither counts as substantive judgment.
diagnostics.citation_precision: Mean over cases with required evidence of (required chars covered by citations / total cited chars). Overly broad citations score low precision despite high recall. Exact-span overlap only; not entailment.
diagnostics.citation_recall: Mean over cases with required evidence of (required chars covered / total required chars).
diagnostics.confusion_matrix: Accepted gold category set versus predicted category; ambiguous sets stay combined.
diagnostics.coverage: Every task must have exactly one outcome. Refused and predeclared API-inapplicable tasks are counted and reported separately.

misleading_advance.A_lexical: retain_candidate on non-useful-or-insufficient gold / scored cases.
misleading_advance.S_C_D_semantic: Unsupported substantive judgments (proposed relationship failing any acceptance check: category/sufficiency/applicability/decision/required-evidence/directed-refs) / scored cases.
misleading_advance.definition: Count cases where the system advances an unsupported relationship or recommends using inappropriate evidence.

model_admission: C/D actual execution and record admission unavailable in 03A-R1; missing governance adapter fails closed. Offline scoring fixtures allowed only by explicit unit-test API flag, never CLI. S surface heuristic is offline deterministic control, no consent gate.

non_use_and_abstention.correct_non_use: Correct set_aside/abstain on non-useful gold (useful_finding=false) / non-useful scored. For S/C/D: accepted judgments with decision in gold decisions on non-useful. For B/B0: abstain on non-useful. For A: abstain only (retains never count).
non_use_and_abstention.correct_insufficient_abstention: Explicit abstentions on insufficient gold cases / insufficient gold cases.
non_use_and_abstention.false_abstention: Abstain decisions on useful gold cases / useful gold cases.
non_use_and_abstention.missed_useful_findings: Useful gold cases minus accepted retained useful findings.

primary.correct_substantive_judgments: Count substantive proposals with accepted category, sufficiency, applicability, decision AND complete required gold evidence coverage.
primary.unsupported_substantive_judgments: Substantive proposals failing any of those adjudicated acceptance conditions. Provisional draft labels do not establish factual falsity.
primary.useful_finding_retention: Accepted evidence-covered substantive findings on useful gold cases / useful gold cases. Unsupported-claim corrections can count as useful. Semantic arms S/C/D only; lexical A reports useful_candidate_recall separately.

unknown_and_pending: Pending/missing gold is unscored and reported incomplete; explicit unknown/insufficient labels are valid epistemic targets, not filled-in answers.
uncertainty: Paired task-level discordances plus family grouping. Wilson 95% intervals are illustrative under an independence assumption not satisfied by template variants; no significance or generalization claims.
